$msg.is_request.description: Tells if the current SIP message is a request or not.

$rtpquery.description: Does a Query command to the RTP proxy and returns the answer in a JSON format.

$ru_q.description: Reference to q value of the R-URI.

$shv(name).description: It is a class of pseudo-variables stored in shared memory.

$si.description: Reference to IP source address of the message.

$sig_local_totag.description: This variable returns the local To-tag that will be used by OpenSIPS for locally sending replies to the current SIP request.

$siprec.description: Used to modify/describe different siprec sessions parameters that should be taken into account by the siprec_start_recording() function.

$socket_in.description: Read-only variable to get the description (proto:ip:port format) of the inbound socket (used for receiving the message).

$socket_out.description: Read-write variable for reading or changing the outbound socket of the message.

$source_uri.description: Returns the URI specification from where a request was received in the form sip:ip:port\[;transport=xxx\] with transport missing if UDP.

$sp.description: Reference to the source port of the message.

$tt.description: Reference to tag parameter of 'To' header.

$ua.description: Reference to user agent header field.
